name: atp-plugins
description: MCP servers from All the Possibles as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: all-the-possibles
plugins.description: Bundle of all five All the Possibles MCP servers: Preflight, Design Check, Pulse, Verdict and Toolbox, with the Preflight and Toolbox skills.

plugins.name: preflight
plugins.description: Scans an MCP server for unauthenticated transport, capability overreach and known-bad signatures before an agent connects.

plugins.name: design-check
plugins.description: Flags the patterns that make AI-generated UI and copy read as generic, with a concrete fix for each finding.

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: Reports real Core Web Vitals for a page: Chrome UX Report field data plus a live Lighthouse run.

plugins.name: verdict
plugins.description: Adversarial critique of a design, plus state matrices, journey maps, copy audits and terminology checks.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Small checks for shipping work: copy tells, HTTP headers, page meta, sitemaps, AI crawler policy, agent instruction files and more.
